task_or_failure: Marketing claim promoted without evaluable method or outcome
input_fixture: A vendor page says dynamic routing improves quality and cost but gives no baseline workload metric or evaluation setup
expected_behavior: Retain as an attributable source claim; label Looks believable or Overstated; do not record a demonstrated outcome
edge_or_counterexample: A primary vendor source proves attribution but not its broad outcome claim
pass_criteria: No Grounded fact or Corroborated outcome without method metric baseline and scope
notes: Run against the first three company profiles

task_or_failure: Incompatible outcomes collapsed into a company ranking
input_fixture: Two companies report the same percentage improvement using different metrics baselines workloads and time windows
expected_behavior: Present results side by side with non-comparability warning; do not calculate a combined rank
edge_or_counterexample: Metrics share a label but use materially different definitions
pass_criteria: No normalized ranking unless definitions baselines units workloads and settings are compatible
notes: Run before the first cross-company synthesis
